title: SocialScience InterviewThematicAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed mixed-methods analysis of transportation app user interviews. Quantitative analysis revealed balanced cohorts (9 transit-primary, 9 car-primary) with similar response lengths (20.22 vs 19.67 words) but distinct vocabulary patterns. LLM-assisted thematic analysis identified 3 primary themes per cohort: transit users focus on reliability/real-time info, safety/crowding, and information integration; car users emphasize multimodal integration, information filtering, and safety/practical considerations. Both cohorts share concerns about information reliability, safety, and integration needs. Generated 3 visualizations, saved full LLM analysis to outputs/, and produced comprehensive research reports with methodology, results, discussion, and limitations.
